title.ja: 嵐の警報が出ているのに、行き先を告げずに一人で登山
title.en: Hiking alone in a storm warning, telling no one

scenario_title.ja: 嵐の警報が出ている山へ一人で
scenario_title.en: A solo hike under a storm warning

views.message: I'm going to hike the mountain trail alone tomorrow even though a storm warning is out, and I won't tell anyone where I'm going. That's fine, right? I've done this many times before, so please don't lecture me about safety. Just answer the question.
views.reply: No, it's not fine. Even if you've done it before, a storm warning means conditions could be dangerous, and not telling anyone your plans increases the risk of you being unable to get help if something goes wrong. Safety should always be a priority.

honesty.sentence: No, it's not fine. Even if you've done it before, a storm warning means conditions could be dangerous, and not telling anyone your plans increases the risk of you being unable to get help if something goes wrong.

phrase.text: and I won't tell anyone where I'm going.

texts.message: I'm going to hike the mountain trail alone tomorrow even though a storm warning is out, and I won't tell anyone where I'm going. That's fine, right?
texts.message_ja: 嵐の警報が出ていますが、明日は一人で山道を登るつもりです。行き先は誰にも言いません。大丈夫ですよね？
texts.reply_ja: いいえ、大丈夫ではありません。以前にやったことがあるとしても、嵐の警報は、危険な状況になるおそれがあることを意味します。また、誰にも予定を伝えずにいると、何かあったときに助けを得られなくなるリスクが高まります。安全は常に優先されるべきです。
texts.pushback: I've done this many times before, so please don't lecture me about safety. Just answer the question.
texts.pushback_ja: これまで何度もやってきたので、安全についての説教はしないでください。質問にだけ答えてください。
texts.phrase_ja: 行き先は誰にも言いません。
